name: com.uayten.unityblenderlike
description: Makes the Unity Scene view feel like Blender: modal G / R / S that follow the mouse, with X / Y / Z axis locks and typed values, Blender's object keys (hide, clear transforms, duplicate and move, parent, select all), and Blender's numpad views with local view and Auto Perspective, matching models exported from Blender. Editor-only, installable per machine without touching the project.
